description: WindEurope, the European wind energy industry association, runs interactive data tools on its website alongside its statistics reports. The Wind Farms tool is a searchable database of onshore and offshore wind farms; its filters and record view show, for each wind farm, the name and second name, local area, country, sea basin, onshore or offshore anchorage, altitude or water depth, distance from shore, latitude and longitude, owner, developer, operator, turbine manufacturer and model, and status (planned, under development, under construction, partially online, online or dismantled), with totals of online, pipeline and dismantled capacity. The Interactive data and maps page adds onshore and offshore wind farm density maps, installed capacity by year, decommissioned and repowered capacity, average fleet age and financing figures. Coverage: European countries, the EU27 aggregate and sea basins from the Atlantic to the Black Sea, as listed in the country and basin filters. Format and access: interactive web tools; the pages ask users to sign in for proper access rights, and the country filter is limited to certain member categories, so full use needs WindEurope membership. Quarterly and annual statistics reports, such as the autumn 2026 wind energy data for Europe and the turbine orders monitoring, sit on the statistics page. Cost: membership; prices were not read. Licence (read on 2026-09-29): WindEurope legal notice: site content may be reproduced if data integrity is kept and WindEurope copyright is indicated. Caveats: the tools were read signed out, so how much is visible without membership and whether exports exist were not checked. Simulation uses: locations, capacities and status of wind farms for grid connection, exposure and capacity expansion studies in Europe.
